# Retro Theme

Vintage / retro theme with sepia tones and serif fonts.

## Install

```bash
npm install @intinyagroup/tokens@alpha
```

## Usage

```svelte
<script>
  import '@intinyagroup/tokens/retro.css';
</script>
```

## Features

- Sepia-toned color palette
- Georgia serif font
- Sharp corners (0px radius)
- Warm, nostalgic feel

## Colors

- Background: cream
- Primary: burnt orange
- Accent: olive, rust, gold
